records.subject: Te electrode system
records.quote: Cyclic voltammetry and AC impedance techniques were used to investigate electrode processes of Te, Bi, and Sb ions (introduced as TeO2, Bi2O3, SbCl3 precursors) on Pt electrode in a ionic liquid consisting in choline chloride - urea ( 1: 2 moles) eutectic as electrolyte.
context_quotes: The concentrations (mM) of precursors in the experiments were: 10.91 TeO2, 5.42 Bi2O3 + 5.45 TeO2, and 3.62 SbCl3 + 7.27 TeO2, respectively.
The working temperature was kept constant at 80 degrees C.
Cyclic voltammograms showed redox couples corresponding to cathodic deposition and anodic dissolution of Te, Bi-Te or Sb-Te.

The processes of Te deposition, as well as BiTe and SbTe co-deposition, were also evidenced by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (Nyquist and Bode diagrams) performed in the same conditions of concentration and temperature.
